name: umaker
description: PBGD-based SSoT workflow plugin with planning, design, development, quality-gate, and deployment skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, verify, and deploy from one SSoT workflow.
interface.longDescription: A PBGD-based workflow plugin that turns source material into plans, designs, implementation, quality checks, reports, and deployment artifacts. Skill bodies are served by the u-maker terminal's embedded skills server.
defaultPrompt: Plan and build this app with umaker (/um-plan, /um-build).
